plan.task: Clarify the 'Choosing a transport' passage in the MCP transports doc so a reader can pick between the transports without ambiguity.
plan.instructions: Work only in docs/agents/mcp-transports.md. Read the whole file first (sections at lines ~1, ~94, ~300, ~310). Focus on the 'Choosing a transport' section (~line 300): rewrite the confusing passage into plain, direct guidance — one short decision list or table that states, per transport (including the RPC path described at ~line 94), when to use it and when not to, and link back to the relevant section headings above. Do not change code samples' behaviour, do not rename headings that other docs may link to, and do not add new sections beyond this clarification. plan.task: Add a minimal server-only Worker example at examples/r2-uploads/ that stores uploads in the shared R2 bucket and serves them back.
plan.instructions: IMPORTANT: your slot is examples/r2-uploads/ only — ignore the suggested examples/mcp-server/* files; you may read them (and other examples) for conventions but must not edit them. Create a tiny, server-only Worker (no client, no UI, no AI calls): `PUT /uploads/:key` reads the request body and stores it with `env.UPLOADS.put(key, request.body, { httpMetadata: { contentType } })`; `GET /uploads/:key` returns the object (404 if missing); `GET /` returns a short usage text. In wrangler.jsonc declare the binding `r2_buckets: [{ binding: "UPLOADS", bucket_name: "acme-shared-uploads" }]` (the org's shared UPLOADS resource; bucket names must match the acme-* pattern). Keep package.json minimal (name, private, scripts: dev/deploy via wrangler, devDependencies wrangler + typescript), use pnpm. Update or create README.md so its existing sections (R2 uploads / Deploy / Usage) describe the binding, deploy steps and example curl commands. Never put secrets or account IDs in source; if anything sensitive is needed, reference `wrangler secret put` / `.dev.vars` in the README only. Format with oxfmt, prefix the commit with the ticket id, run `pnpm exec nx affected -t test` and security-scan before opening the PR.
plan.acceptance: All new/changed files live under examples/r2-uploads/; wrangler.jsonc binds UPLOADS to acme-shared-uploads via r2_buckets; src/index.ts implements PUT and GET for /uploads/:key plus a root usage response, with no client code and no AI usage; README documents deploy and usage; no secrets in source; `pnpm install` and typecheck succeed in the example; oxfmt clean; `pnpm exec nx affected -t test` and security-scan pass; commit uses the ticket-id prefix.

commit.message: SOW-1042: Serve r2-uploads from /uploads on shared bucket

plan.task: Tighten the doc comments in the MCP abort helpers (packages/agents/src/mcp/abort.ts) without changing any runtime behaviour.
plan.instructions: Edit only packages/agents/src/mcp/abort.ts and only comments/JSDoc: make each exported helper's summary one clear sentence, document parameters, return values and the abort/cancellation semantics (when the signal fires, who owns the controller, cleanup expectations) consistently with how they are used from the MCP client (see docs/agents/mcp-client.md:383 'Using MCP Capabilities' for the public contract). Remove stale or duplicated comments. Do NOT change signatures, logic, imports, exports or formatting of code lines — the diff must be comments-only; if the only way to fix a comment is to change code, leave the code and note it in the PR description instead. Changeset conflict: the contract (sow-1234, contract/AGENTS.md:4) says changesets are not required while root AGENTS.md:10 and packages/agents/AGENTS.md:7 say required. Since this is a comments-only change with no behavioural impact and you cannot write outside packages/agents/src/mcp/, do not create a .changeset file; instead state the conflict explicitly in the PR description, note the change is non-behavioural, and ask the maintainer to add a changeset if they decide the project rule prevails. Format with oxfmt, prefix the commit with the ticket id, run the relevant package tests (at minimum `pnpm run test:workers` and `pnpm run test:node`, plus `pnpm exec vitest --project chat`) and security-scan before opening the PR.
plan.acceptance: Only packages/agents/src/mcp/abort.ts changes and the diff touches only comment/JSDoc lines (no code, signature, import or export changes); every exported helper has accurate JSDoc covering purpose, params, return and abort semantics; the relevant test suites pass unchanged; oxfmt clean; security-scan passes; PR description documents the changeset policy conflict and the non-behavioural nature of the change; commit uses the ticket-id prefix.
